newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African govt repeats no plans to seek IMF loan.
newsitem.headline: S.African govt repeats no plans to seek IMF loan.

text.p: South Africa has no plans to seek an International Monetary Fund (IMF) loan in the near-term, a finance department spokeswoman said on Thursday, reiterating previous policy statements.

She was reacting to an earlier report from stockbroker PLJ van Rensburg that the country would have no choice but to seek a $2 billion IMF loan by the end of February next year in view of an expected outflow of foreign exchange.
